name: PhD in Quantitative Biomedical Sciences (QBS)
detailsNote: Official information available. December 1 is published without a year, so it is not confirmed for Fall 2027.
summary: Dartmouth PhD in quantitative biomedical sciences at the Geisel School of Medicine. Students are not required to secure an advisor before applying and do rotations with different QBS faculty.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Official page gives this date without a year; not confirmed for Fall 2027. Confirm the Fall 2027 date with the program.

timeline.interviews: Remote interviews with faculty, students and alumni are held mid-January.
timeline.decisions: Admissions notifications are sent by mid-February.

english.note: Required for non-US citizens unless the degree is from a US or Canadian institution or the language of instruction was English. The scores are recommended ranges from the Graduate Studies page, which is dated 2025. Self-reported scores are accepted when applying; official results are required after admission.

applicationFee.note: No waiver terms were found on the pages opened.

requirements.note: QBS FAQ: GRE scores may be self-reported; an official report is required if an offer is made.

funding.note: QBS FAQ: PhD students receive tuition coverage, a monthly stipend and healthcare benefits. No stipend amount is given.

international.note: 'Typically, one third to one half of the PhD class will be international students.'
